entries.test: Public controlled studies testing whether generalization beyond training examples limits reliable reasoning and planning in the specified neural-network configurations.
entries.note: The preceding sentence supplies the referent of 'That'.

entries.test: Public technical studies and documented developer decisions showing whether generalization limitations drive increased data requirements and ethically consequential data practices.
entries.note: This asserts a causal influence on developer conduct, not merely an inaccessible private motive. The ethical choices are an asserted effect, not a condition.

entries.test: Public demonstrations testing whether increasing training data alone can overcome outlier-driven generalization failures in the neural-network configurations under discussion.
entries.note: In context, 'enough' means enough to overcome the stated generalization limitations. The indefinite horizon does not make this firm claim uncheckable.

entries.test: Public evaluations demonstrating reliable LLM performance on unfamiliar cases, together with controlled studies testing whether generalization limitations cause persistent failures.
entries.note: The extracted proposition explicitly retains the causal explanation as well as the permanent prediction. Reliability here concerns reasoning and planning beyond training examples.

entries.test: Public evidence of AGI achieved through scaling existing approaches without an alternative approach that improves generalization beyond training data would falsify the claim.
entries.note: This asserts a necessary technical requirement, rather than merely recommending a research direction. 'End of story' expresses certainty, not a condition.
